plan.name: POS BIR Annex B Items 4 to 14 Readiness

execution_boundary.section_scope: Convert the approved Section 02 control matrix into a versioned, testable requirements registry.

status_model.internal_pass_rule: Every evidence obligation must be generated, reviewed, and checksum-verified before an item may be INTERNAL_PASS.
status_model.not_applicable_rule: A NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE decision requires a reviewer, review date, rationale, and an explicit supported-scope statement.
status_model.external_boundary: Internal readiness does not claim BIR, TWG, tax-practitioner, provider, eAccReg, PTU, ATG, or eSales acceptance.

requirement_catalog.FR-401: Generate a receipt/invoice sample matrix for each supported Item 4 scenario.
requirement_catalog.FR-402: Generate adjustment documents for cancel, void, return, and refund where applicable, each linked to the original document number.
requirement_catalog.FR-403: Generate X-reading and Z-reading samples with reconciled totals and identifiers.
requirement_catalog.FR-404: Inventory every report that can be generated and attach a sample printout for each report selected as applicable.
requirement_catalog.FR-405: Generate a receipt-complete .txt e-journal plus hard-copy projection and checksum manifest.
requirement_catalog.FR-406: Maintain versioned system narrative, screenshots, operating manual, audit extract, and DRP.
requirement_catalog.BR-401: Unsupported or legally unresolved scenarios are not silently marked complete; they require N/A rationale or external review status.
requirement_catalog.BR-402: Original fiscal documents are never mutated by adjustments, reprints, or later configuration changes.
requirement_catalog.BR-403: Offline records remain provisional and cannot be included as final fiscal issuance until server replay succeeds.
requirement_catalog.REP-401: All evidence exports carry tenant, location, terminal, date range, generator version, and checksum metadata.

test_catalog.TEST-420: Matrix: every Item 4-14 row has a fixture/evidence type, status, owner, and acceptance gate.
test_catalog.TEST-421: Fixture: run each Item 4 discount/charge fixture and compare receipt, report, audit, and journal values.
test_catalog.TEST-422: Adjustment: create each applicable adjustment and verify the original document number appears in document, audit, and journal.
test_catalog.TEST-423: N/A review: reject an item marked complete when it has neither evidence nor signed N/A rationale.

acceptance_catalog.AC-420: The control matrix contains exactly Items 4 through 14 and preserves the PDF's distinction between software behavior and documentary submission.
acceptance_catalog.AC-421: Each applicable Item 4 scenario produces a stable sample with no conflicting totals across receipt, report, audit, and journal.
acceptance_catalog.AC-422: Every Item 5 sample includes the original document number and a non-destructive adjustment status.
acceptance_catalog.AC-423: The matrix supports a computed 100 percent internal score only when all required evidence gates pass.

evidence_contract.provisional_rule: Offline/provisional records must be identified and excluded from final fiscal issuance evidence until server replay succeeds.

items.checklist_requirement: Sample OR/SI output for all supported transaction, discount, and charge types.
items.implementation_target: Scenario fixture matrix consumed by the server-authoritative receipt contract and shared renderer.

applicability.rule: Every supported DGFY transaction, discount, and charge scenario is applicable; unsupported or legally unresolved discounts require an explicit reviewer decision.

evidence_obligations.description: One stable hard-copy/PDF/text sample for each applicable Item 4 fixture, plus fixture manifest and field-review record.

items.status_reason: The Section 02 matrix is registered, but scenario-complete samples, reconciliation, checksum evidence, and legal field review are not yet generated.

items.checklist_requirement: Adjustment document for Cancel, Void, Return, Refund, etc., linked to original document number.
items.implementation_target: First-class adjustment lifecycle and immutable original-document linkage; explicit Return decision.

applicability.rule: Each supported adjustment type is applicable; unsupported provider/refund types require explicit N/A rationale and must not be silently omitted.

decision.decision: Return is a distinct adjustment type linked to the original document; payment refund is a separate linked adjustment.

evidence_obligations.description: One sample per applicable adjustment type with original-document linkage, API/audit evidence, and non-destructive status.

items.status_reason: The internal Return contract is locked for readiness work; runtime Return behavior and original-document-linked adjustment samples are not implemented.

items.checklist_requirement: X-Reading and Z-Reading sample print copies.
items.implementation_target: Reconciled reading service, print projection, date/terminal scope, and immutable Z snapshot.

applicability.rule: X-Reading, Z-Reading, and the associated day-close scope are applicable to each fiscal terminal that supports them.

evidence_obligations.description: X and Z sample printouts with transaction reconciliation, identifiers, immutable snapshot evidence, and close event evidence.

items.status_reason: Runtime reading support exists, but controlled reconciled print samples and freshness evidence are not yet generated.

items.checklist_requirement: List of other reports and sample printout of each.
items.implementation_target: Report catalog with applicability, owner, filters, export format, and sample generator.

applicability.rule: Every report the POS or related fiscal/reporting surface can generate must be catalogued; non-applicable reports require rationale.

evidence_obligations.description: Signed report inventory with one applicable sample output per report and applicability decisions for the remainder.

items.status_reason: The requirements registry is defined, but the complete applicable report catalog and sample printouts are not proven.

items.checklist_requirement: Soft and hard e-journal in .txt format containing all receipt/invoice records and applicable adjustments.
items.implementation_target: Versioned serializer, completeness checker, deterministic line order, hard-copy projection, and checksum manifest.

applicability.rule: The e-Journal must cover all applicable issued fiscal documents and applicable adjustment records; provisional offline records remain explicitly excluded until replay.

evidence_obligations.description: Raw receipt-complete .txt, rendered hard-copy projection, completeness/reconciliation manifest, and checksum record using the locked internal grammar.

items.status_reason: The internal readiness grammar is locked; runtime serialization, completeness checking, hard-copy projection, and reconciliation evidence are not implemented.

items.checklist_requirement: Narrative system description and design/structure of the Sales Machines or Software.
items.implementation_target: Controlled narrative generated from current architecture, data flow, security, offline, and fiscal lifecycle.

applicability.rule: The narrative and system-flow evidence are documentary submission artifacts; they must describe the current implementation and declared limitations.

evidence_obligations.description: Reviewed current system narrative and flow diagram with source revision, owner, reviewer, and checksum.

items.status_reason: The existing narrative and flow sources need a current-system refresh and reviewer record.

items.checklist_requirement: Software name/version on login, home, and splash if applicable.
items.implementation_target: Single version identity source and evidence capture for applicable surfaces.

applicability.rule: Capture applicable login/home/splash surfaces from the exact local build; a missing splash surface requires reviewer-authored N/A rationale.

evidence_obligations.description: Redacted login/home/splash screenshots where applicable and a version-consistency register.

items.status_reason: The version component exists, but exact-build surface evidence and consistency review are missing.

items.checklist_requirement: Screenshot of the online or offline indicator, if applicable.
items.implementation_target: Truthful network/API reachability indicator with documented semantics and offline restrictions.

applicability.rule: Capture each applicable network/API state and prove provisional restrictions and replay behavior; if offline mode is not supported, record that decision explicitly.

evidence_obligations.description: Online/offline/API-unreachable/reconnected screenshots and behavior log documenting indicator truthfulness and fiscal restrictions.

items.status_reason: Network/API state evidence and replay/restriction semantics are not yet captured and reviewed.

items.checklist_requirement: Machine brochure or operating manual, if applicable.
items.implementation_target: Versioned operator manual and hardware/peripheral applicability decision.

applicability.rule: Provide the operator manual and device matrix for supported peripherals; hardware not used by the filing target requires a signed applicability rationale.

evidence_obligations.description: Versioned operator manual and device applicability matrix with owner, reviewer, and checksum.

items.status_reason: The operator manual and hardware applicability decision are not yet versioned and reviewed.

items.checklist_requirement: Printed system audit trail or activity log with date/time, user, activity, and data values.
items.implementation_target: Filtered, authorized, secret-scrubbed export/print view with complete field mapping.

applicability.rule: Audit evidence is applicable to fiscal and configuration activity; export must be authorized, filterable, checksumed, and secret-scrubbed.

evidence_obligations.description: Filtered printed/exported audit sample and field-coverage record for date/time, actor, activity, values, linkage, authorization, and redaction.

items.status_reason: Print-ready audit export and complete field/redaction coverage evidence are not yet generated and reviewed.

items.checklist_requirement: Narrative backup procedure and disaster recovery plan.
items.implementation_target: Versioned DRP with RPO/RTO, backup scope, restore drill, encryption, owners, and escalation.

applicability.rule: Backup, restore, encryption, and fiscal-record hash verification are applicable to the local readiness target; evidence must use a controlled drill and current source revision.

evidence_obligations.description: Versioned backup/DRP, latest restore drill, encryption verification, and fiscal-record hash comparison with sign-off.

items.status_reason: Current DRP, restore, encryption, and fiscal-record freshness evidence are not yet generated and signed off.
